Write the answer.” | 3 | Ask: | “What is 10 more than 516?” | Note: | Expected: | 526 | . Which is worth more?”

Section 5 · I Do: the anchor chart (10 min) | Watch: | Same digit. | Pupils who say “they are the same” are looking at digits. Ask for values. | 1 | Do: | Show 10 rods next to 1 flat. They match. | Note: | 10 tens is 1 hundred. | 2 | Do: | Put anchor chart up. Point to 195 and 10. | 3 | Say: | “The 1 in 195 is in the hundreds place.” | Note: | Step 1: worth | 100 | . | 4 | Say: | “The 1 in 10 is in the tens place.” | Note: | Step 1 again: worth | 10 | . | 5 | Say: | “100 is 10 times 10.” | Note: | Step 2: circle | 10 times | . | 6 | Say: | “Now the other way: 5 is one tenth of 50.” | Note: | Another example. Walk and check. | Note: | Expected ★★: | 40, 4, 10 times | . | 6 | Say: | “Left is ten times. Right is one tenth.” | Note: | The chant. Say it twice together.
